mapper.select: SELECT tx.amount FROM transactions tx JOIN transfers t ON t.transfer_id = tx.transfer_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND tx.status = 'SUCCESS' AND tx.amount > 0 AND tx.transferred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 180 DAY AND tx.transferred_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY tx.transferred_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT tx.amount FROM transactions tx JOIN transfers t ON t.transfer_id = tx.transfer_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND tx.recipient_id = #{recipientId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND tx.status = 'SUCCESS' AND tx.amount > 0 AND tx.transferred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 180 DAY AND tx.transferred_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY tx.transferred_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT recipient_id) FROM transfers WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')
